source: PyTorch v2.10.0 test files (raw.githubusercontent.com/pytorch/pytorch/v2.10.0), run with the installed torch 2.10.0+cu128 on RTX A6000

what_they_compare.test_fused_matches_forloop: fused vs forloop implementation, same dtype (bf16 included), tiny synthetic model (Linear 2-3-1), 7 iterations, assertEqual with default tolerances (bf16: rtol 1.6e-2, atol 1e-5)
what_they_compare.test_compiled_optimizers check_optim: compiled vs eager parameters and state, float32 only (dtypes=[torch.float32]), default fp32 tolerances (rtol 1.3e-6, atol 1e-5) except Adadelta / NAdam
